title: Microsoft Teams: desk utilisation analytics in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: Hold: the permission guidance incorrectly suggests that either Exchange or Places permissions suffice to change building visibility, whereas Microsoft requires both. The access-control row also reports no automation despite documented Microsoft Graph assignment of the Entra roles that grant portal access. The rollout dates, desk licensing requirements and principal configuration commands are supported.
